description: Simple, private drink tracker with a filling glass, streaks and reminders Hydro Homie helps you drink enough, without getting in your way. Log a drink with one tap, or dial in an exact amount with the wheel (10 ml steps). The glass on the home screen fills up as you go, and a short confirmation shows that your entry was saved. Features • Quick-add buttons for water, tea, coffee, juice, soda and more – every drink counts with its own hydration factor • Amount wheel in 10 ml steps • History with a two-week chart and a three-month calendar • Daily goal, streaks and achievements • Extra water for physical activity and hot or cold weather • Optional drink reminders with a soft water-drop sound • Home-screen widget for one-tap water logging • Light and dark theme, English and German Privacy No account, no ads, no analytics. Everything stays in a local database on your device. The app is offline by default; only if you switch on the optional "Fetch weather automatically" setting does it ask for coarse location and load the current temperature from Open-Meteo (coordinates rounded to ~10 km). The app is free software (GPL-3.0).
